title: Tech stocks fall as Intel has its worst day since 1974
caption:
US tech stocks fell sharply on Friday as investors questioned whether huge AI spending will pay off soon. Intel lost almost 29% after a weak forecast, and the Nasdaq dropped 2.9%. Both the Nasdaq and the S&P 500 ended October with a monthly loss.

One story. Twice a day. Follow for the next edition.
